newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms seek 52,500 tonnes of corn-traders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms seek 52,500 tonnes of corn-traders.

text.p: A group of South Korean feed milling companies, known as the Big Feed Mills, jointly invited tenders to buy on Friday 52,500 tonnes of corn, traders said.
Arrival was set by September 30 to the western ports of Inchon and Kunsan, they said.
Traders said shipment was set for August 27 to September 15 if sourced from the Pacific Northwest, for August 12 to 31 if from the U.S. Gulf or for September 11 to 30 if from China.
However, sellers of Chinese corn are also allowed to split the amount into 36,000 tonnes for arrival to Inchon and 13,000 tonnes to Kunsan, they said.
